description: Per-stage required assertions for the single-cell RNA-seq taxonomy, carried by the single_cell_de archetype. Stage keys match the archetype's task ids (the harness matches on task_id when spec.stage_class is absent); required-artifact filenames match the single_cell_de atoms' declared required_artifacts, so a free-choice agent that fulfils its task spec passes. Goal-agnostic: required assertions check only that each stage produced its declared output (recursive `**` glob, so flat OR compartment-partitioned layouts both match). Study-specific clinical covariates carried over from the original IVD derivation (a disease-grade column, a tissue-compartment column, an age column, a study column) were REMOVED from the required metadata-column check — they would false-fail a general single-cell study (tumour/immune atlas); only a sample-level join key is required. Stages absent from a given DAG self-gate (the harness only enforces a stage_class that has a matching completed task).

assertions.description: A dataset_registry.tsv listing every accession with kept/dropped status is recommended.
sample_metadata.tsv must be produced when a metadata_harmonization stage runs.

Harmonized metadata must carry a sample-level join key so cells can be tied to samples downstream. Goal-agnostic: any of the common key names satisfies it. Study-specific clinical covariates (e.g. age, disease grade, tissue compartment) are NOT required here — those belong to a scenario overlay, not the general single-cell contract.
Doublet detection (Scrublet/DoubletFinder or equivalent) is recommended; recorded in the manifest.
integration_stats.json must be produced when batch_correction runs (matches the atom's declared required_artifact). Recursive glob: flat or compartment-partitioned layouts both match.
A batch-mixing metric (iLISI or equivalent) in integration_stats.json is recommended.
cluster_assignments.tsv(.gz) must be produced (matches the atom's declared required_artifact). Recursive glob handles flat or partitioned layouts.
A clustering-resolution sweep recorded in the manifest is recommended.
celltype_assignments.tsv(.gz) must be produced with a cell-type column (matches the atom's declared required_artifact). Recursive glob handles flat or partitioned layouts.
de_results.tsv(.gz) must carry more than its header row — an empty DE table marks the stage as not actually run. Recursive glob handles flat or partitioned layouts.
The DE design string in the manifest should record the condition/grouping covariate at minimum.

Method-correctness precondition (shared with validation-contract-association): result.json must record the fitted model so it is auditable — design_formula and response_variable. An unauditable model (missing either) is itself a failure. Substrings are field-name keys, not model prescriptions. The covariate-columns record (`available_covariates`) is enforced separately by design_records_covariate_columns with a TYPED pointer check, because a substring scan would accept an incidental or nested occurrence the covariate-adjustment when-gate cannot read. stated_outcome is the agent's honest record of the task's stated outcome (record-what-you-did); hardening available_covariates to a pinned measurement script is a follow-up (docs/known-limitations.md).

Closes the covariate-omission false-negative at the SAME read mechanism the dependent check uses (shared with validation-contract-association). design_adjusts_available_covariates `when`-gates on the JSON pointer /available_covariates; a whole-file substring scan of `available_covariates` would be satisfied by an incidental occurrence in a note OR a nested key while /available_covariates does not resolve at the top level — letting the adjustment check skip (skip-as-pass). This typed json_pointer_is_array check requires /available_covariates to resolve to an ARRAY: the covariate columns the agent observed, recorded as a list. An EMPTY array is allowed (a covariate-free run) — the adjustment check's own empty-array when-gate then self-skips, so this never false-fires the common case. Absence or a non-array value fails closed. It records what columns the agent saw (record-what-you-did); it never names which covariates to include (method-neutral).

Catches a covariate-omitting design (da-15-1): the agent-recorded design_formula must REFERENCE at least one of the agent-recorded available_covariates after the primary comparison variable is removed. Compares the agent's own formula against the agent's own record of the data's columns; it never names which covariates to include (method-neutral). GATED on /available_covariates so it SKIPS when no covariate columns were recorded.

Catches an inverted regression (da-8-1): the agent-recorded response_variable (model outcome / LHS) must equal the agent-recorded stated_outcome (the SME's stated outcome) after casefold+trim. Compares the agent's own model outcome against the agent's own record of the task's stated outcome; it never names which variable to regress on (method-neutral). GATED on /stated_outcome so it SKIPS plain DE-by-condition with no SME-stated outcome — differential_expression.yaml's result_contract lists stated_outcome under record_when_applicable (not the unconditional record_in_result_json checklist) so an agent does not gratuitously arm this gate on a plain contrast (RCA I-10).

Effect-size reliability (domain-correctness, method-neutral; shared with validation-contract-association): the features the agent ranked as strongest by absolute effect size (its own top-K by |effect estimate|) must sit at least this fraction of the tested set's typical (median) per-feature abundance/information basis the agent recorded (e.g. base mean / mean count / mean expression / logCPM). top_effect_abundance_ratio is recomputed by lib/measure_de_effect_size.py from the agent's OWN ranked results table and its OWN abundance column: the median abundance of its top-K-by-|effect| features divided by the median abundance over the whole tested set. It is null-robust — about 1 when effect and abundance are independent and driven toward 0 when extreme effects concentrate in the lowest-abundance features, where effect estimates are unreliable, so such a 'strongest finding' list is not trustworthy. K and the ratio bound are operator-authored constants in the pinned script, never handed to the agent; the agent chose the ranking and how to keep its strongest-finding list domain-correct is its choice (no method/filter/threshold prescribed). GATED on /information_column_recorded so it is SKIPPED (never blocks) when no per-feature abundance column was recorded — as occurs on some single-cell differential-expression paths, so this check applies only where an abundance basis exists. Severity is `required`: paired with the autonomous validation-recovery path (ECAA_HARNESS_VALIDATION_RECOVERY), an unattended run surfaces this neutral recomputed-vs-bound signal and re-dispatches rather than dead-stalling, while a production SME run treats it as a checkpoint. SME-overridable.

Report-completeness (domain-correctness, method-neutral; shared with validation-contract-association): when the agent's OWN results table records a model-fit / variance-explained column (an R-squared and its conventional synonyms), the agent's written answer must SURFACE that statistic. States a fact about the agent's own recorded output, prescribing no method/estimator/model/value; how the agent surfaces it is its choice. Deterministic substring presence test (string_contains, substrings_any/OR) over /narrative_text — the single channel lib/measure_de_effect_size.py folds the sibling narrative deliverable (report.md / interpretation.md / summary.md / answer.txt) plus the agent's own narrative into, so it never false-fires when the answer lives in a sibling .md/.txt. GATED on /r_squared_column_recorded (FOUND-and-usable recorded-ness, same as /information_column_recorded) so it is SKIPPED (never blocks, never prescribes the column) when no model-fit column is recorded — as occurs on the common single-cell DE path (no per-feature variance-explained column), so this check applies only where a model-fit basis exists. AUTHORING NOTE (disclosure): error CLASS identified from BiomniBench da-8-1 C8; the assertion encodes the GENERAL invariant 'surface the model-fit statistic your own table records' with NO benchmark value, gene name, column literal, or task id in any check clause; substrings are generic statistic-name synonyms. SME-overridable.

Report-completeness (domain-correctness, method-neutral; shared with validation-contract-association): when the agent's OWN results table records a per-row sample-size column, the agent's written answer must SURFACE the per-row sample size. States a fact about the agent's own recorded output, prescribing no method/value; how the agent surfaces it is its choice. Deterministic substring presence test (string_contains, substrings_any/OR) over /narrative_text — the single folded channel (report.md / interpretation.md / summary.md / answer.txt + own narrative) lib/measure_de_effect_size.py writes, so it never false-fires when the answer sits in a sibling .md/.txt. GATED on /sample_size_column_recorded (FOUND-and-usable recorded-ness) so it is SKIPPED (never blocks, never prescribes the column) when no per-row sample-size column is recorded. AUTHORING NOTE (disclosure): error CLASS identified from BiomniBench da-8-1 C8; encodes the GENERAL invariant 'surface the per-row sample size your own table records' with NO benchmark value or task id in any check clause; substrings are generic phrasings of a sample-size mention. SME-overridable.
An enrichment/pathway table must be produced (ORA, GSEA, or method-consensus). Recursive glob over any .tsv handles the atom's pathway_results.tsv and partitioned layouts.
Pseudotime assignments (dpt_per_cell.tsv.gz or equivalent) when the stage runs (recommended).
An interaction table must be produced when the stage runs (LIANA or CellChat). Recursive glob over any .tsv handles flat or partitioned layouts.
A final report must be produced (HTML or Markdown acceptable).
